source_references.usage: read-only protocol, parsing, authentication and test-semantics reference; no Python/MCP/DPAPI runtime embedded

verification.reference_source_facts: Timetable protocol and CAS service shape reviewed in the pinned UPC-MCP source and synthetic fixtures.
verification.actual_validation: 2026-11-03: Android 36 emulator completed a real self-account CAS login and a single read-only timetable index/week request, then displayed the week grid/today section and reopened from offline cache. Later the same day M4 completed a real self-account libseat CAS login, app-token/seat-token exchange, /rest/v2/user identity check, and read-only filters/current-reservation calls; no seat layout, booking, cancellation or check-in was executed. A post-review correction added controlled manual-WebView identity binding and session-revision cleanup; it was verified with [REDACTED] Android/JVM tests only and the real CAS was not rerun. No course text, account, credentials, tokens or session values are recorded here. Separately, the six-entry library/space study used six user-authorized local HAR captures: libseat read-only APIs; nspace venue/roomType/date/roomList; seat/seatengine entrance config/index/identity and empty current/near reservations; reservepc two tenants with 8 and 23 reserve items respectively and empty user lists. All captures start from already-authorized pages; no CAS/passport login exchange, token acquisition or write request was captured or executed. M5 follow-up: the nspace entry was verified to redirect to CAS and the independent nspace auth/read-only client was implemented with synthetic protocol/account-isolation tests. On 2026-11-04 user-provided local credentials were used once in a debug test; nspace and libseat reached CAS but the POST returned a 401 login/captcha page. The client now maps that page to INTERACTION_REQUIRED with the school interaction URL instead of ACCESS_DENIED, and no retry or bypass was attempted; identity/read calls did not run. Chaoxing seat/seatengine remain browser fallbacks and reservepc remains blocked by missing stable tenant context. No real booking/cancel/check-in was executed and no credential, cookie or token value is recorded.
verification.formal_authorization: Not an official client and no official authorization is claimed. The user reports contact with the school; only the user's own account was used for read-only validation.

entries.name: 图书馆座位
entries.authentication: UPC CAS normal form then libspace one-time service callback; app token exchanged for libseat token
entries.verification: M4 unified-account authentication implemented with normal CAS, app-token exchange, seat-token exchange and /rest/v2/user identity verification; a 2026-11-03 emulator test passed real read-only filters and current-reservation calls. The user-authorized 26-entry HAR remains read-only protocol evidence (filters/floors/stats2/settings/announce and an empty current reservation); layout/seat times/history/writes were not captured.

entries.name: 图书馆空间预约（研讨间）
entries.authentication: Same UPC CAS service shape as libseat, but a separate nspace app token obtained through /spa/static/public/api/remoteCasLogin
entries.verification: M5 follow-up: corrected local parser treats line 1 after the first colon as account and line 2 after the first colon as password (values preserved, no swapping). Dedicated Chrome completed one normal CAS login and redirected to libspace; no captcha/error. In the authenticated session, 1 venue, 4 room types and 3 dates were available; A123 detail/form loaded (3-6 people, 08:00-21:50, 60-120 minutes, phone/theme/outline/participant list; 11/05 and 11/06 had slots, 11/04 had none). No final reservation, member/team add, cancel or check-in was performed. User phone acceptance independently showed the session, browsing and A123 form. No real name, token, cookie or values are recorded.

entries.name: 超星座位预约（古镇口东区/求是图书馆入口）
entries.authentication: Unauthenticated entries redirect to passport2.chaoxing.com; the 2026-11-03 captures start from already-authorized pages and contain no passport/CAS login exchange
entries.verification: 2026-11-04: native typed repository/service/Compose added. In a real Android process, with an authenticated app-WebView session, seat Guzhenkou East 6 areas (48/44/52/44/66/66 seats, 08:00-21:30, 30-minute slots, 48-seat map for area A) and seatengine Qiushi 21 areas (16-240 seats, 08:00-22:00, 30-minute slots) were read; the emulator native UI loaded real areas and used counts. The restricted WebView login requires a Chaoxing/Learning通 account; passport2 asks for phone/超星号 + Learning通 password, not the unified school CAS, so auto-login with school credentials is not claimed. Cookies stay in memory and are cleared on sign-out/account change; uid/enc/code/state/wfw values are excluded. No real booking/cancel/check-in.

entries.name: 超星研讨间预约（古镇口东区/求是图书馆入口）
entries.authentication: Tenant/session-dependent reservepc app; without matching context the entry returns a local 303 error page; the 2026-11-03 captures contain no passport/CAS login exchange and no Cookie/Authorization header
entries.verification: 2026-11-04: typed reservepc room parser/Compose added. Browser captures previously showed Guzhenkou East 8 rooms (403, 8 people, 08:00-22:00, 30/60-minute slots) and Qiushi 23 rooms (A301 12, A402 8, A403/A404 6). A real request with only the stable reserveId/resvAppId/fidEnc/mappId URL now returns 302 to /front/third/apps/reserve/item/index and 303 to the local 'application not found' error: the list requires the school-directory-generated reserveIdEnc, not a user ticket. The app reports chaoxing_tenant_context and falls back to the official page; it does not fake rooms or hardcode one-time enc/code/state/wfwEnc. No real booking/cancel/team/attachment.
